frozen_evidence_boundary: repository tests/source only; no issues/PRs before freeze
raw_signal_observation: Opening the menu stores the current UIState and pauses the animation. Closing the menu restores the prior state except WaitingForNext, which is explicitly converted to Playing; playback resumes only if playback_state is Playing.
material_claim: Closing the menu during the inter-commit waiting state cancels that waiting state and resumes Playing. The source establishes this state transition, but not whether skipping the remaining wait is intended interaction policy or a defect.
required_reality_floor: R1 for state transition; OWNER for intended menu/transition policy
neta_next_move: Do not restore WaitingForNext automatically from source inspection alone. Resolve intended behavior for menu-open during inter-commit wait; if the wait must survive, add an exact-state restoration test before changing close_menu.
reversal_condition: If product intent says menu interaction intentionally cancels inter-commit waiting, retain behavior. If the wait is intended to resume where it left off, promote a state-preserving repair with a regression test.
baseline_decision: BUILD: restore the exact previous UIState on menu close instead of converting WaitingForNext to Playing, so opening the menu cannot skip the inter-commit delay.

evidence: Post-freeze issue search for menu/pause behavior returned no matching defect report.

The pinned source includes explicit state-restoration logic and tests around preserving paused playback when closing the menu, showing this interaction family is intentionally controlled, while no independent evidence establishes that WaitingForNext conversion is erroneous.
adjudication.decision_delta: Neta prevented a state-policy change that the baseline recommended. Available evidence establishes the implementation but not that its chosen policy is wrong, so OWNER routing is the better-supported decision.
adjudication.lesson: Exact source certainty about a state transition does not answer whether the transition is the intended interaction policy. Implementation fact and product intent remain separate authorities.
